mentions.text:
Yesterday was the first time in several weeks where I bought any stocks 

(Outside of NVDA which I bought at 166 and then sold for 165 the next day when we got the 2nd affair news)

I have been a seller of a good portion of my AI infra over the past few weeks and will continue to be on any multi day strength we may see. The fragility has only gotten stronger each week and it is (obviously) not the same trade as before. 

I still have around 20% of my portfolio in AI infra and would like for 1) that weight come down and 2) to concentrate into a much fewer number of positions that I believe are best positioned for a reduction in hyperscaler capex or a slowdown in the build. The reason I stay interested here is because of all the sectors out there, I think AI infra has the most meaningful upside torque where, if I can be successful with timing with a tactical sleeve, I can take advantage of the volatility. But it is very challenging and I have not had much success with it lately.

I see every range of strategies from buying the dip daily to shorting every pop. 

I think everyone should obviously play the strategy that works best for them

Most of my time right now is spent trying to find opportunities with no exposure to capex/data centers that are being pulled down with the rest of tech. 

Companies that will be durable and where I can justify their valuation

Its tough. There are markets outside of tech that are in their own bubble and I have no interest in rotating a meaningful amount of capital into those just to get top blasted. I owned stocks like $WMT for a bit, but if it started dropping meaningfully I would not be able to defend the valuation at all. 

One thing I intend to implement going forward as well will be more of a L/S strategy. I had some good hedges the past few months with TLT calls, QQQ puts etc. But not meaningful enough size. 

So the past few weeks I've been sitting on ~50% cash and yesterday I deployed ~12% of that. 

I deployed some starters/adds into companies like $OMDA $BKSY $AMBA 

But even with these companies I am still prepared for another significant drawdown and will be happy to continue to deploy some cash slowly

I have taken a break from X because I have honestly been very discouraged by whats happening to the platform. As someone that does their best to be a very respectful person, seeing what people are willing to do/say on here is very concerning.

But that being said, there are so many people that I do want to engage with, and putting out content on here will make me a sharper investor and think through things deeper as well

I am going to keep my posts to 'accounts you follow can reply' so if you want to engage please dm me and ill follow you back so we can have conversations in the comments

I dont have any ego in this and am very open to dialogue/discussion even if it is in total disagreement to what I think. 

But I have zero tolerance for disrespect and putting other people down. I won't participate it and I won't allow it on my platform

Hopefully we can get some constructive conversations going!
